+import sys
+import time
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+R = Robot()
+SPEC = R.spec()
+Q_DOWN = np.array([0.0, 1.0, 0.0, 0.0], dtype=float)
+
+
+def pose_from_now():
+    return np.asarray(R.get_obs(video="none").meta["proprio"]["now"][7:14], dtype=float)
+
+
+def ee_line(start, end, speed=0.12, dt=0.05, note=""):
+    """Move in small Cartesian steps with the brush kept vertical."""
+    a = np.asarray(start, dtype=float)
+    b = np.asarray(end, dtype=float)
+    length = float(np.linalg.norm(b[:3] - a[:3]))
+    n = max(1, int(np.ceil(length / (speed * dt))))
+    t = np.linspace(1.0 / n, 1.0, n)
+    P = np.empty((n, 7), dtype=np.float32)
+    P[:, :3] = a[:3][None, :] + (b[:3] - a[:3])[None, :] * t[:, None]
+    P[:, 3:] = Q_DOWN
+    return R.submit("ee_pose", P, dt=dt, video="none", note=note)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    cur = pose_from_now()
+    print("status", R.status())
+    print("tip", cur.tolist())
